menu.title: Sword · Flow
menu.subtitle: Victory decided in a fleeting instant
menu.mode_hint: Solo: challenge five opponents in a row. Versus: two players on one PC.
menu.char_select_hint_solo: Choose your fighter and begin the solo ladder.
menu.char_select_hint_versus: Each player picks a fighter and input: both keyboard, one keyboard and one gamepad, or two gamepads (P1 uses gamepad 1, P2 uses gamepad 2). A gamepad connected mid-duel goes to P1.

char_b.name: Swift Blade
char_b.desc: 11-frame windup, fastest recovery, 7 damage per cut

char_c.name: Heavy Blade
char_c.desc: 40 HP, 15 damage per cut plus 12 frames of stagger, longest windup

start_slot.name: Training
start_slot.desc: Gain one random insight at the start of each run

hard_mode.name: Asura Mode
hard_mode.desc: Foes are faster, stronger, and far more perilous. Try not to fall too quickly.

tutorial.start: Hold your breath and focus; wait for the blade
tutorial.attack: Their blade has yet to return; strike the opening
tutorial.flow: Flow runs low; gather your mind first
tutorial.spell: [PLACEHOLDER] Spell ready: press L to cast
tutorial.wait: Blades locked; do not move rashly

u01.name: Iron Wall
u01.desc: Guard lasts 3 more frames; fast cuts are easier to catch

u04.name: Clear Mind
u04.desc: Start each duel with +10 flow for an easier opening

u05.name: Edge Glimpse
u05.desc: The opponent's blade warning appears 6 frames earlier

u06.name: See-Through
u06.desc: At 50+ flow, spend 30 flow to negate one hit (once per duel)

u07.name: Pursuit
u07.desc: After landing a hit, your next attack within 3s deals +10 damage (once per duel)

u08.name: Guts
u08.desc: No flow loss for 5s after taking a hit

u09.name: First Strike
u09.desc: Slash windup -3 frames from second 3 to 8

u10.name: Renewal
u10.desc: Healing after each win is doubled

spell_a.name: Zanshin
spell_a.desc: Assume a stance: for 45 frames an incoming cut is parried perfectly and answered with a 10-damage counter that ignores guard; if no cut comes, 10 flow is refunded; attacking first cancels the stance.

spell_b.name: Grand Flurry
spell_b.desc: After an 8-frame charge, strike automatically for 20 damage, ignoring the opponent's guard

spell_c.name: Sky Tyrant
spell_c.desc: After a 20-frame charge, strike for 30 damage, ignoring guard and adding stagger

spell_boss.name: Lingering Reverie
spell_boss.desc: After a 14-frame charge, strike for 30 damage, ignoring guard and adding stagger
